Microsoft.summary:
Black & Veatch reached 98% adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot through deliberate change management, including early-adopter cohorts that surfaced real business use cases.
The clearest lessons come from Frontier Firms, the group last year’s research introduced: the top 10% of organizations on IDC’s AI maturity scale.
The lesson from Frontier Firms is one I believe every leader can act on: scaling AI value means managing models, agents, governance and measurement as one accountable system.

Microsoft.title: Arm AppReady for Windows gives developers a faster path to native Windows on Arm applications
Microsoft.titleEn: Arm AppReady for Windows gives developers a faster path to native Windows on Arm applications
Microsoft.titleKo: Windows용 Arm AppReady는 개발자에게 Arm 애플리케이션의 기본 Windows에 대한 더 빠른 경로를 제공함
Microsoft.summary:
The next wave of applications will define the Windows on Arm experience As Arm-powered Windows devices reach more users, the value of the experience will show up in the software – how quickly a creative app makes content available, how smoothly a security product operates in the background, how efficiently a development environment handles local workloads, or how responsive and reliably an AI-enabled application runs without excessive power consumption.
The Windows on Arm ecosystem continues to expand, driven by growing OEM adoption and rising user demand for lightweight, power efficient, responsive, and AI-enabled PCs and laptops, as well as increasing investment from software vendors in building native Arm versions of their applications.
Check whether key dependencies have Windows on Arm-native versions; Review build systems, compiler settings, installers, and plug-ins; Identify architecture-specific code and performance-critical paths; Find Arm and Microsoft guidance for native Windows on Arm development; Explore AI-enabled tools and practices that can help scan code, identify portability issues, and speed up porting tasks.
summaryLinesEn: The next wave of applications will define the Windows on Arm experience As Arm-powered Windows devices reach more users, the value of the experience will show up in the software – how quickly a creative app makes content available, how smoothly a security product operates in the background, how efficiently a development environment handles local workloads, or how responsive and reliably an AI-enabled application runs without excessive power consumption.

The Windows on Arm ecosystem continues to expand, driven by growing OEM adoption and rising user demand for lightweight, power efficient, responsive, and AI-enabled PCs and laptops, as well as increasing investment from software vendors in building native Arm versions of their applications.

Check whether key dependencies have Windows on Arm-native versions; Review build systems, compiler settings, installers, and plug-ins; Identify architecture-specific code and performance-critical paths; Find Arm and Microsoft guidance for native Windows on Arm development; Explore AI-enabled tools and practices that can help scan code, identify portability issues, and speed up porting tasks.
summaryLinesKo: 차세대 애플리케이션은 Windows on Arm 경험을 정의할 것임 · Arm 기반 Windows 장치가 더 많은 사용자에게 도달함에 따라 경험의 가치는 소프트웨어에 나타날 것임 · 즉, 창의적인 앱이 콘텐츠를 얼마나 빨리 제공하는지, 보안 제품이 백그라운드에서 얼마나 원활하게 작동하는지, 개발 환경이 로컬 워크로드를 얼마나 효율적으로 처리하는지, AI 지원 애플리케이션이 과도한 전력 소비 없이 얼마나 반응적이고 안정적으로 실행되는지 등이 여기에 해당됨
Windows on Arm 에코시스템은 OEM 채택 증가와 경량, 전력 효율성, 반응성이 뛰어난 AI 지원 PC 및 노트북에 대한 사용자 수요 증가, 애플리케이션의 기본 Arm 버전 구축에 대한 소프트웨어 공급업체의 투자 증가로 인해 지속적으로 확장되고 있음

주요 종속성에 Arm 네이티브 버전의 Windows가 있는지 확인하세요 · 빌드 시스템, 컴파일러 설정, 설치 프로그램 및 플러그인을 검토함 · 아키텍처별 코드와 성능에 중요한 경로를 식별함 · 기본 Windows on Arm 개발에 대한 Arm 및 Microsoft 지침을 찾아보세요 · 코드를 스캔하고, 이식성 문제를 식별하고, 이식 작업 속도를 높이는 데 도움이 되는 AI 지원 도구와 사례를 살펴보세요

Microsoft.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.
summaryLinesEn: Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.

That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.
summaryLinesKo: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임
이러한 플러그인은 현재 ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot에서 기본적으로 작동하므로 팀은 Databricks에서 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 유지하고 선호하는 에이전트에서 사용할 수 있도록 할 수 있음

NVIDIA.summary:
When reached by phone Wednesday and asked about his relationship with Ms.
Jensen Huang, the leader of Nvidia who is under investigation for an affair with a woman who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese spy, also had an extramarital relationship with an executive who reports to him, according to five people who worked at the company.
The company’s shares fell about 8 percent in after-hours trading.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA, OpenShell 기부 및 새로운 AI 인프라를 통해 오픈 소스 지원 확대
NVIDIA.summary:
Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.
NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.
summaryLinesEn: Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.

NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.
summaryLinesKo: 세 가지 새로운 오픈 소스 프로젝트는 DSX AI Factory 플랫폼을 확장하여 Kubernetes를 더 쉽게 실행하고 추론을 더 빠르게 확장할 수 있도록 함
CNCF에 대한 NVIDIA의 OpenShell 기여는 자율 에이전트를 위한 보안 인프라를 커뮤니티의 손에 맡겨 구축, 검사 및 개선함으로써 개발을 가속화하고 보호 장치를 강화함
이를 충족하기 위해 NVIDIA는 Kubernetes 및 클라우드 네이티브 커뮤니티를 위한 대표 컨퍼런스인 KubeCon + CloudNativeCon에서 오픈 소스에 대한 헌신을 심화하고 있음

NVIDIA.title: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
NVIDIA.titleEn: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
NVIDIA.titleKo: Arm과 NVIDIA: 에이전트 AI 시대를 위한 신뢰할 수 있는 컴퓨팅 기반 구축
NVIDIA.summary:
Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.
summaryLinesEn: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.

Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.
summaryLinesKo: Arm의 Jeff DeFilippi는 @TheNextPlatform과 대화를 통해 에이전트 AI 워크로드용 인프라를 평가할 때 대기 시간, 동시성 및 랙당 완료된 작업이 중요한 이유를 공유함
IDC에 따르면 Arm 기술은 모든 주요 하이퍼스케일러에 배포되었으며 Arm 기반 랙 규모 서버는 이제 x86을 가속 컴퓨팅의 주요 플랫폼으로 추월함
또한 에이전트 인프라에는 에이전트 자체가 실행되는 환경 외부의 정책을 관찰, 격리 및 관리할 수 있는 독립적인 컴퓨팅이 필요함

NVIDIA.summary:
Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box.
They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services.
NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies .

NVIDIA.title: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleEn: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleKo: 칩부터 기술까지, 엔비디아와 한국, 소버린 AI 협업 확대
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.
Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.

이번 협력은 한국 NPU 및 XPU 기업이 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 생태계에 참여할 수 있는 토대를 마련하고 GPU 활용도를 강화하기 위한 NVIDIA 교육 및 인증 프로그램, 해커톤 및 기술 세미나를 포함함

NVIDIA.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleEn: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 한국의 AI 생태계는 NVIDIA를 통해 Agentic AI를 발전시키고 보호함
NVIDIA.summary:
Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts.
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts.
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .
summaryLinesKo: Nemotron-Personas-KOREA는 공식 한국 통계에 기초한 700만 개의 완전 합성 한국 페르소나로 구성된 공개 데이터세트로, 모델 작성자가 한국 상황에서 훈련 데이터와 평가를 기반으로 사용함
AI 에이전트가 더 많은 작업을 수행함에 따라 AI 에이전트와 함께 발전할 수 있는 개방형 모델과 보안이 필요함
모델 측면에서 LG AI Research는 Nemotron-Personas-KOREA를 포함한 NVIDIA Nemotron 데이터 세트를 사용하여 개발된 K-EXAONE-2.5에 대한 애플리케이션 프로그래밍 인터페이스 액세스를 공개함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA, 과기정통부-NVIDIA AI 스타트업 파트너십 포럼에서 한국 스타트업에 대한 새로운 투자 계획 발표
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.
The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.
Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.
summaryLinesKo: NVIDIA는 또한 Motif Technologies, RLWRLD 및 Upstage에 대한 추가 투자 계획과 함께 한국 스타트업 Point2에 대한 투자를 발표함
계획된 투자는 스타트업이 우대 가격, 기술 전문 지식 및 투자자 소개 기회를 이용하여 성장할 수 있도록 돕는 프로그램인 NVIDIA Inception의 한국 기반 회원 1,000명 이상을 포함하여 한국 스타트업 및 벤처 커뮤니티와의 NVIDIA의 협력을 기반으로 함
AI 상호 연결 회사인 Point2 Technology는 AI 공장의 칩과 랙 간에 데이터를 이동하는 확장 가능한 무선 주파수 기반 상호 연결을 구축하여 AI 클러스터 확장을 위한 기존 구리 및 광 상호 연결 솔루션에 대한 혁신적인 대안을 제공하고 차세대 AI 인프라에 필요한 도달 범위, 성능 및 효율성을 제공함

Apple.title: Rumored Apple Smart Glasses Mentioned in Supplier's Earnings Briefing
Apple.titleEn: Rumored Apple Smart Glasses Mentioned in Supplier's Earnings Briefing
Apple.titleKo: 공급업체의 수익 브리핑에서 언급된 소문난 Apple 스마트 안경
Apple.summary:
The company claimed it has been involved in "Apple's AI glasses and new smart earphones projects," which could boost demand for its machine vision inspection equipment.
Apple is reportedly targeting a late 2027 launch for its first smart glasses, expected to help answer questions about the wearer's surroundings and translate languages.
Apple's rumored smart glasses and AirPods with cameras may have been referenced by Chinese manufacturing equipment supplier Quick Intelligent Equipment, according to a Securities Times report on the company's quarterly earnings briefing.

Use Gemini in CarPlay to catch-up on what you have coming up in your schedule, talk through your inbox, or · pic.twitter.com/1s4luZ6q0v To use the assistant on CarPlay, you'll need to make sure you have the latest version of the Gemini app on your iPhone and the microphone permissions are on

The company suggested drivers could use Gemini to prep for a meeting during their commute, catch up on emails, hear their Daily Brief or get recommendations for local places worth checking out in an area

Apple.title: Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay
Apple.titleEn: Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay
Apple.summary:
The next time you connect your phone to your car, tap the Gemini icon on your CarPlay display, then start a new conversation or pick up a recent one.
Talk through your inbox: Because Gemini connects with your Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Calendar, you can ask for your daily brief 1 , catch up on unread emails, get quick summaries of long email threads, and talk through a quick reply using just your voice.
Pick up where you left off — or start a fresh conversation You can talk back and forth with Gemini at your own pace — interrupting to add a detail, changing the subject, or pausing when you need to focus on an exit.

받은 편지함을 통해 대화 · Gemini는 Gmail 및 Google Calendar와 같은 Google Workspace 앱과 연결되므로 일일 요약을 요청하고 1 읽지 않은 이메일을 확인하고, 긴 이메일 스레드에 대한 빠른 요약을 받고, 음성만으로 빠른 답장을 통해 대화할 수 있음

Apple.title: MacPaw Launches 'Eney' AI Assistant for Mac and iPhone
Apple.titleEn: MacPaw Launches 'Eney' AI Assistant for Mac and iPhone
Apple.titleKo: MacPaw, Mac 및 iPhone용 AI 도우미 'Eney' 출시
Apple.summary:
A Starter plan with 10,000 AI credits costs $14.99/month, a Boost plan with 25,000 credits costs $29.99/month, and a Power plan with 50,000 credits costs $49.99/month.
Eney for Mac is available to download from eney.ai and requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later.
The app also surfaces Mac care warnings for low disk space, memory pressure, and crashing apps, and connects to Apple Mail, Calendar, and Reminders out of the box, plus Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Jira, and Linear.

Apple.summary:
It seems likely that Apple will expand intelligence usage packs to other Creator Studio apps, such as Final Cut Pro and Pixelmator Pro.
Apple has made it clear for a while that Siri AI is bound by daily usage limits and that it will offer expanded access via iCloud+ plans.
It has started selling $50 intelligence usage packs for Creator Studio, and Logic Pro is the first app to support these.

Apple.title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
Apple.titleEn: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
Apple.titleKo: Apple의 50달러 Intelligence Usage Pack은 일부 AI 기능에 대한 액세스를 확장함
Apple.summary:
Users finding themselves running out of access can find the option to buy an Intelligence Usage Pack in the Intelligence Features > Show Usage section of the app’s main menu.
After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to “Buy More Usage” for a one-time purchase price of $49.99, as spotted by 9to5Mac .
These Intelligence Usage Packs, as Apple calls them, will allow users to continue accessing certain Apple Intelligence features that have usage limits because they rely on cloud-based AI models from OpenAI or Google Gemini.

9월 초 일부 Apple Intelligence 기능에 대한 사용 제한을 설명하는 지원 기사를 게시한 후 회사는 9to5Mac에서 발견한 대로 일회성 구매 가격 $49.99에 "추가 사용량 구입" 옵션으로 Logic Pro를 업데이트함

Google DeepMind.title: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Deepmind는 AlphaGenome 2를 통해 유전체학 AI를 대량 조직 예측에서 단일 세포 유형 분해능으로 전환함
Google DeepMind.summary:
AlphaGenome 2 pinpoints disease genes and vaccine responses more accurately On the TenK10K benchmark dataset with 28 primary immune cell types, AlphaGenome 2 identified about 30 percent of causal variants.
Google Deepmind has introduced AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts gene changes in specific human cell types.
It was trained on more than 107 million individual cell profiles from 68 tissues, according to Google Deepmind , and is meant to help researchers uncover the cellular drivers of disease.

Google Deepmind는 특정 인간 세포 유형의 유전자 변화를 예측하는 AI 모델인 AlphaGenome 2를 출시함

Google DeepMind.summary:
According to Google, Hydrogen beats the larger Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at the default "high" thinking level (51 vs. 50) and reaches up to 54 at the highest level, "xhigh."

Google DeepMind.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Google DeepMind.summary:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
For workflows that require parallel agents, Carbon can act as the coordinator while Hydrogen can power worker and verifier agents to build and test changes simultaneously across isolated workspaces — helping teams ship complex projects faster without driving up token costs.
To explore large repositories efficiently, the model excels at natively batching file-read and search calls in parallel rather than inspecting files one by one; in early testing across complex graphs, SQL, and data-heavy enterprise workflows, our partners have seen Hydrogen run 2x to 2.8x faster while reducing token usage by 12% to 23%, compared to 3.8 Flash.

summaryLinesKo: Gemini 4 Hydrogen의 가격은 100만 개 토큰 컨텍스트 창 전체에 걸쳐 입력 토큰 100만 개당 1.50달러, 출력 토큰 100만 개당 7.50달러로 균일하게 책정됨
병렬 에이전트가 필요한 워크플로의 경우 Carbon은 코디네이터 역할을 할 수 있고, Hydrogen은 작업자와 검증자 에이전트가 격리된 작업 공간에서 변경 사항을 동시에 구축하고 테스트할 수 있도록 지원하여 팀이 토큰 비용을 들이지 않고도 복잡한 프로젝트를 더 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 돕음

대규모 리포지토리를 효율적으로 탐색하기 위해 이 모델은 파일을 하나씩 검사하는 대신 기본적으로 파일 읽기 및 검색 호출을 병렬로 일괄 처리하는 데 탁월함 · 복잡한 그래프, SQL 및 데이터 집약적인 기업 워크플로에 대한 초기 테스트에서 파트너는 Hydrogen이 3.8 Flash에 비해 토큰 사용량을 12%~23% 줄이면서 2배~2.8배 더 빠르게 실행되는 것을 확인함

Google DeepMind.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 개발자를 위한 일상적인 코딩 및 에이전트 워크플로
Google DeepMind.summary:
With tighter instruction following and fewer fabricated claims, it helps you ship cleaner, production-ready code faster.
Built for rapid iteration, Hydrogen handles repository coding and debugging, interactive web development, and multimodal workflows — running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon.
Read the Google Antigravity blog to see how new features like Orchestrator pair Hydrogen with Gemini 4 Carbon.
summaryLinesEn: With tighter instruction following and fewer fabricated claims, it helps you ship cleaner, production-ready code faster.

Built for rapid iteration, Hydrogen handles repository coding and debugging, interactive web development, and multimodal workflows — running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon.
Read the Google Antigravity blog to see how new features like Orchestrator pair Hydrogen with Gemini 4 Carbon.
summaryLinesKo: 더 엄격한 지시 사항을 준수하고 조작된 주장이 적기 때문에 더 깨끗하고 생산 가능한 코드를 더 빠르게 제공하는 데 도움이 됨

The following comparison uses illustrative prices (always benchmark against your own data and current Bedrock pricing ): Model A: (6,150 x $0.50 + 750 x $1.50) / 1,000,000 = $0.0042 Model B: (1,000 x $1.00 + 150 x $3.00) / 1,000,000 = $0.00145 Figure 2: Why the higher-priced model costs 65% less.

Anthropic.titleEn: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
Anthropic.titleKo: Clipto를 사용하면 ChatGPT와 Claude가 수년간의 사람들의 회의와 화상 통화를 검색하고 분석할 수 있음 · - SiliconANGLE
Anthropic.summary:
For instance, a management consultant could ask ChatGPT to pinpoint the exact time when a project’s scope changed by looking at more than six month’s worth of calls and meetings, and it will surface the exact moment when that occurred.
It’s this shortcoming that a startup called Clipto Inc. is trying to solve with the launch of a new AI chatbot memory platform called Clipto Studio, which enables AI assistants to listen in on calls, presentations and meetings and search through them or analyze them upon request.
We’re building the technology to make video and audio as accessible and as useful to AI as text, opening up an entirely new generation of applications.”

Anthropic.title: Introducing Claude 4
Anthropic.summary:
To accommodate the additional steps Claude incurs by utilizing more thinking, the maximum number of steps (counted by model completions) was increased from 30 to 100 (most trajectories completed under 30 steps with only one trajectory reaching above 50 steps).
Finally, we've introduced thinking summaries for Claude 4 models that use a smaller model to condense lengthy thought processes.
New API capabilities: We’re releasing four new capabilities on our API that enable developers to build more powerful AI agents: the code execution tool, MCP connector, Files API, and the ability to cache prompts for up to one hour.

Anthropic.title: Anthropic says AI is eroding Nvidia's CUDA lead, cutting an AMD chip switch from months to three days
Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic says AI is eroding Nvidia's CUDA lead, cutting an AMD chip switch from months to three days
Anthropic.titleKo: Anthropic은 AI가 Nvidia의 CUDA 선두를 침식하여 AMD 칩 스위치를 몇 달에서 3일로 단축하고 있다고 말함
Anthropic.summary:
According to Anthropic's S-1/A registration statement filed with the SEC on November 10, 2026, Nvidia is also participating in a conditional private placement totaling $26 billion , in which seven technology companies are subscribing to shares at the IPO price.
And because of its dominance in the AI chip market, Nvidia currently enjoys a margin of more than 70 percent, which is unusually high for hardware.
When porting to AMD GPUs, Anthropic's own frontier model Mythos wrote or ported nearly 100 percent of the kernels itself, reportedly in just three days instead of the usual six to twelve months.

Anthropic.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Anthropic.titleEn: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
Anthropic.titleKo: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Anthropic.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.
summaryLinesKo: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임
이러한 플러그인은 현재 ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot에서 기본적으로 작동하므로 팀은 Databricks에서 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 유지하고 선호하는 에이전트에서 사용할 수 있도록 할 수 있음

OpenAI.title: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleEn: Clipto enables ChatGPT and Claude to search and analyze years of people's meetings and video calls - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: Clipto를 사용하면 ChatGPT와 Claude가 수년간의 사람들의 회의와 화상 통화를 검색하고 분석할 수 있음 · - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
For instance, a management consultant could ask ChatGPT to pinpoint the exact time when a project’s scope changed by looking at more than six month’s worth of calls and meetings, and it will surface the exact moment when that occurred.
It’s this shortcoming that a startup called Clipto Inc. is trying to solve with the launch of a new AI chatbot memory platform called Clipto Studio, which enables AI assistants to listen in on calls, presentations and meetings and search through them or analyze them upon request.
We’re building the technology to make video and audio as accessible and as useful to AI as text, opening up an entirely new generation of applications.”

We’re building the technology to make video and audio as accessible and as useful to AI as text, opening up an entirely new generation of applications.”
summaryLinesKo: 예를 들어, 관리 컨설턴트는 ChatGPT에 6개월 이상의 통화 및 회의를 살펴보고 프로젝트 범위가 변경된 정확한 시간을 정확히 찾아달라고 요청할 수 있으며, 해당 시간이 발생한 정확한 순간이 드러날 것임
클립토(Clipto Inc.)라는 스타트업이 AI 비서가 통화, 프레젠테이션, 회의 내용을 듣고 검색하거나 요청 시 분석할 수 있는 새로운 AI 챗봇 메모리 플랫폼인 클립토 스튜디오(Clipto Studio)를 출시하면서 이러한 단점을 해결하려고 함
우리는 비디오와 오디오를 텍스트만큼 AI에 접근 가능하고 유용하게 만드는 기술을 구축하여 완전히 새로운 세대의 애플리케이션을 열어가고 있음”

OpenAI.titleKo: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
OpenAI.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

OpenAI.summary:
ChatGPT currently reaches 1.2 billion users per week, according to OpenAI, and the company plans to expand the offering to more markets and industries over time.
Eligible US e-commerce and online service providers can also create "Business Agents," AI agents that answer customer questions in ChatGPT, help with product comparisons, and can serve as targets for ChatGPT ads.
OpenAI is launching a beta feature called "Businesses in ChatGPT" that could compete with Google's "MyBusiness."

SpaceX.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
SpaceX.titleEn: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
SpaceX.titleKo: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
SpaceX.summary:
Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.
That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

summaryLinesKo: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임

Databricks.title: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: How Block powers collaborative AI agents with Buzz and Unity Gateway | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Block이 Buzz 및 Unity Gateway를 통해 협업 AI 에이전트를 강화하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
As an open source project, Buzz is model-agnostic and can be self-hosted, meaning it can run privately on your own network or system, giving users flexibility in how they deploy and configure their agents.
With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
At Block, Databricks Unity Gateway helps power the Buzz experience by providing access to a broad selection of frontier and open-weight models through a single integration.
summaryLinesEn: As an open source project, Buzz is model-agnostic and can be self-hosted, meaning it can run privately on your own network or system, giving users flexibility in how they deploy and configure their agents.

With Databricks Unity Gateway, employees who use Buzz can access frontier and open-weight models, experiment with different agent harnesses, and find the right combination based on the efficiency frontier for each task.
At Block, Databricks Unity Gateway helps power the Buzz experience by providing access to a broad selection of frontier and open-weight models through a single integration.
summaryLinesKo: 오픈 소스 프로젝트인 Buzz는 모델에 구애받지 않고 자체 호스팅이 가능함 · 즉, 자체 네트워크나 시스템에서 비공개로 실행될 수 있어 사용자가 에이전트를 배포하고 구성하는 방법에 유연성을 제공함
Buzz를 사용하는 직원은 Databricks Unity Gateway를 사용하여 프론티어 및 개방형 모델에 액세스하고, 다양한 에이전트 하네스를 실험하고, 각 작업의 효율성 프론티어를 기반으로 올바른 조합을 찾을 수 있음
Block에서 Databricks Unity Gateway는 단일 통합을 통해 다양한 프론티어 및 개방형 모델에 대한 액세스를 제공함으로써 Buzz 경험을 강화하는 데 도움을 줌

Databricks.title: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Lakehouse//RT: Scale real-time analytics, not your bill | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Lakehouse//RT: 청구서가 아닌 실시간 분석 확장 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
And with growing demand for use cases like customer-facing dashboards that refresh in milliseconds and applications with embedded analytics, real-time workloads are quickly becoming a standard part of how businesses use data.
Lakehouse//RT is intentionally built to absorb that demand without a proportional cost increase Customers that chose Lakehouse//RT over separate real-time serving layers report 6x to 10x lower infrastructure costs AI agents are pushing the limits of data warehouses.
And even when a warehouse can deliver low latency, the bill grows as fast as demand: 10x the queries could easily mean 10x the cost.

summaryLinesKo: 그리고 밀리초 단위로 새로 고쳐지는 고객 대면 대시보드와 내장된 분석 기능이 있는 애플리케이션과 같은 사용 사례에 대한 수요가 증가함에 따라 실시간 워크로드는 기업에서 데이터를 사용하는 방식의 표준 부분으로 빠르게 자리잡고 있음
Lakehouse//RT는 비례적인 비용 증가 없이 해당 수요를 흡수하도록 의도적으로 구축됨 · 별도의 실시간 서비스 계층 대신 Lakehouse//RT를 선택한 고객은 인프라 비용이 6~10배 더 낮다고 보고함 · AI 에이전트는 데이터 웨어하우스의 한계를 뛰어넘고 있음
그리고 창고가 짧은 대기 시간을 제공할 수 있더라도 청구서는 수요만큼 빠르게 증가함 · 즉, 쿼리가 10배 증가하면 비용이 10배 증가할 수 있음

Databricks.title: How H6.ai builds AI-powered financial automation with Lakebase Postgres | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: How H6.ai builds AI-powered financial automation with Lakebase Postgres | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: H6.ai가 Lakebase Postgres를 사용하여 AI 기반 금융 자동화를 구축하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Traditional accounts payable and invoice processing tools often force companies into a trade-off: moving quickly using AI automation and risk losing control, or maintaining tedious manual oversight.
H6.ai gives every customer a dedicated Lakebase Postgres database, which keeps each customer's financial data isolated on a multi-tenant AP automation platform.
It is how we build AI-powered financial automation that customers can trust.

H6.ai는 모든 고객에게 전용 Lakebase Postgres 데이터베이스를 제공하여 각 고객의 재무 데이터를 멀티 테넌트 AP 자동화 플랫폼에 격리시킴

Databricks.title: Eclipse Aerospace simplifies flight-data ingestion with Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Eclipse Aerospace simplifies flight-data ingestion with Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Eclipse Aerospace는 Databricks를 사용하여 비행 데이터 수집을 단순화합니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Eclipse Aerospace relies on Databricks to store nearly 20 years of flight data, totalling more than 3TB.
It supports its service centers and engineers with data from more than a million flight hours, sourced and verified across multiple sources, including: near-real-time satellite telemetry; large bulk uploads of full flight histories; and external data sources.
For Eclipse Aerospace, a very light jet manufacturer and operator, partnering with Databricks offered a way to make nearly two decades of proprietary flight data more accessible to service centers and engineers without adding costly, always-on infrastructure.

For Eclipse Aerospace, a very light jet manufacturer and operator, partnering with Databricks offered a way to make nearly two decades of proprietary flight data more accessible to service centers and engineers without adding costly, always-on infrastructure.
summaryLinesKo: Eclipse Aerospace는 Databricks를 사용하여 약 20년간의 비행 데이터(총 3TB 이상)를 저장함

Databricks.title: Dispelling LTAP myths | Databricks Blog
Databricks.summary:
Logical replication replays every change through a pipeline that must keep up, which makes it a costly way to build the lake copy.
That is why Postgres stays fast, analytics stays fresh, and no CDC pipeline is needed Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.
Four readings came up often: “A single copy of the data can have only one physical layout, so either point lookups or scans must be slow” “Iceberg or Delta tables on object storage are inherently stale”
summaryLinesEn: Logical replication replays every change through a pipeline that must keep up, which makes it a costly way to build the lake copy.

That is why Postgres stays fast, analytics stays fresh, and no CDC pipeline is needed Lakebase's LTAP design makes the lake the database's storage, not a replica: one Delta or Iceberg table, one catalog, with Postgres caches and pageservers in front for speed.

Four readings came up often: “A single copy of the data can have only one physical layout, so either point lookups or scans must be slow” “Iceberg or Delta tables on object storage are inherently stale”
summaryLinesKo: 논리적 복제는 유지되어야 하는 파이프라인을 통해 모든 변경 사항을 재생하므로 레이크 복사본을 구축하는 데 비용이 많이 듬
이것이 바로 Postgres가 빠른 속도를 유지하고 분석이 최신 상태를 유지하며 CDC 파이프라인이 필요하지 않은 이유임 · Lakebase의 LTAP 설계는 호수를 복제본이 아닌 데이터베이스의 스토리지로 만듬 · 하나의 Delta 또는 Iceberg 테이블, 하나의 카탈로그, 속도를 위해 Postgres 캐시와 페이지 서버가 앞에 있음
4가지 판독값이 자주 나왔음 · "데이터의 단일 복사본에는 하나의 물리적 레이아웃만 있을 수 있으므로 포인트 조회나 스캔이 느려야 함" · "객체 스토리지의 Iceberg 또는 Delta 테이블은 본질적으로 오래됨"

Sierra AI.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.
Update: On 10/9, we shared a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, with 35 new design partners including Bank of America, OpenAI, Visa, and United Airlines.

Sierra AI.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.
So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

Sierra AI.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.summary:
Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognizes privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.
“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realizing that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realizing that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

최고의 고객 경험 AI 플랫폼인 Sierra는 오늘 JPMorganChase의 혁신 전당에 입성한다고 발표함
Chase의 최고 정보 책임자(CIO)인 Gill Haus는 “Agentic AI는 고객을 위해 더 간단하고 직관적인 경험을 제공할 수 있는 잠재력을 갖고 있지만, 그 잠재력을 실현하려면 처음부터 신뢰, 보안 및 통제력을 확보해야 함” · 라고 말함

Scale AI.title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
Scale AI.titleEn: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
Scale AI.titleKo: 전 세계 도시에서는 NVIDIA Physical 및 Agentic AI를 사용하여 AI 서비스를 구축하고 확장함
Scale AI.summary:
Cities can extend AI to more services by building on infrastructure already in place and adding capacity.
In Wrocław, Poland , K2K is building shared AI infrastructure using NVIDIA accelerated computing, NVIDIA Cosmos world reasoning models, and NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) to transform existing camera streams into actionable intelligence for mobility, safety and event response — using the same infrastructure across several city functions.
City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.
summaryLinesEn: Cities can extend AI to more services by building on infrastructure already in place and adding capacity.

City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.
summaryLinesKo: 도시는 이미 존재하는 인프라를 구축하고 용량을 추가하여 AI를 더 많은 서비스로 확장할 수 있음

폴란드 브로츠와프에서 K2K는 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, NVIDIA Cosmos 세계 추론 모델, 비디오 검색 및 요약(VSS)을 위한 NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint를 사용하여 공유 AI 인프라를 구축하고 있으며, 이를 통해 여러 도시 기능에서 동일한 인프라를 사용하여 기존 카메라 스트림을 이동성, 안전 및 이벤트 대응을 위한 실행 가능한 인텔리전스로 변환하고 있음
도시 팀은 이러한 AI 서비스 구축을 시작하기 위해 막대한 인프라 투자가 필요하지 않음 · 워크로드에 따라 NVIDIA RTX 워크스테이션 또는 소형 GPU 시스템이면 충분할 수 있음

ElevenLabs.title: How ElevenLabs' CTO is rolling out AI agents—and why he thinks bigger efficiency gains are ahead for the voice AI startup | Fortune
ElevenLabs.titleEn: How ElevenLabs' CTO is rolling out AI agents—and why he thinks bigger efficiency gains are ahead for the voice AI startup | Fortune
ElevenLabs.titleKo: ElevenLabs의 CTO가 AI 에이전트를 출시하는 방법과 음성 AI 스타트업이 더 큰 효율성 향상을 이룰 것이라고 생각하는 이유 | 행운
ElevenLabs.summary:
The AI voice startup has deployed an inbound sales development representative (SDR) agent that has handled over 3,000 customer leads this year, qualifying over 90% of those potential clients in 32 different languages without any human intervention.
Marvell says the deal will allow the combined company to address a market worth $550 billion, with Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy saying, “AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an opportunity that comes along once in a generation.”
He says that the efficiency gains ElevenLabs reaps from agentic AI may feel cutting edge today, but “in six months time, you can see even more gains.”

Marvell은 이번 거래를 통해 합병된 회사가 5,500억 달러 규모의 시장에 진출할 수 있게 될 것이라고 말했으며, Matt Murphy 회장 겸 CEO는 "AI 인프라는 광 연결을 향한 근본적인 아키텍처 변화를 겪고 있으며 한 세대에 한 번씩 찾아오는 기회를 창출하고 있습니다"라고 말함

Lovable.title: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleEn: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleKo: 프런트엔드를 Firestore에서 이전하고 Lovable Realtime을 구축한 방법 | 사랑스럽
Lovable.summary:
The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.
When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

각 사용자가 수신한 내용을 결정하고 데이터와 권한이 변경됨에 따라 해당 결정을 최신 상태로 유지하기 위해 백엔드가 필요함

Lovable.summary:
More than 100,000 pull requests in our codebase later, my co-founder Fabian and our team of engineers, designers, and product managers have turned that plan into Lovable, and our users have created more than 70 million projects on the platform to date.

Later that year I wrote down the plan for Lovable : people who couldn’t code would create, deploy, and improve software through chat and instantly see the result.

Suno.summary:
It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.
As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

Hugging Face.titleEn: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang's exit
Hugging Face.titleKo: Hugging Face CEO, Jensen Huang 퇴임 후에도 오픈 소스 AI를 위해 계속 싸울 것이라고 맹세
Hugging Face.summary:
Nvidia had announced its plan to acquire the platform for open source AI models in September for $12.9 billion, making it the second-largest acquisition in the company’s history, just behind that of chipmaker Groq’s assets for $20 billion in December 2025.
Last month, Nvidia expanded its Nemotron family of open-weight models with a large 120-billion-parameter model for agents used by the enterprise as well as with two new lightweight Bolt models that run on PCs.
Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C In August, Nvidia also announced a $6 billion deal with the coding startup Poolside to help build out an open AI ecosystem in the U.S. to help the country compete against Chinese companies like DeepSeek and Kimi K3, The Wall Street Journal reported at the time.

At 4 bits per residual coordinate, 200 vectors of 128 dimensions require 12.8 KB of quantized residuals per document, or 12.8 GB across a million documents.

Hugging Face.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
Hugging Face.titleEn: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
Hugging Face.titleKo: BotPsy: 수십억 매개변수 에이전트 언어 모델을 갖춘 온디바이스 개인 비서
Hugging Face.summary:
BotPsy achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) tool-use and agentic performance for its size, outperforming every model of up to 1.2B parameters that we tested (Figures 1 and 2).
As intelligence per parameter continues to improve rapidly, we aim to stand at the forefront of this shift toward performant, privacy-focused, self-hosted models.
Twice the performance of its base model: BotPsy roughly doubles the agentic capability of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Think on key benchmarks: BFCL v4 rises from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5 (mean of the retail, telecom and banking subsets).

매개변수당 지능이 지속적으로 빠르게 향상됨에 따라 우리는 성능이 뛰어나고 개인 정보 보호에 초점을 맞춘 자체 호스팅 모델을 향한 이러한 변화의 최전선에 서는 것을 목표로 함

매개변수당 지능이 지속적으로 빠르게 향상됨에 따라 우리는 성능이 뛰어나고 개인 정보 보호에 초점을 맞춘 자체 호스팅 모델을 향한 이러한 변화의 최전선에 서는 것을 목표로 함
기본 모델 성능의 두 배 · BotPsy는 Qwen3.5-0.8B의 에이전트 기능을 대략 두 배로 늘림 · 주요 벤치마크에 대해 생각해 보세요 · BFCL v4는 23.4에서 44.0으로, ACEBench는 30.1에서 58.7로, τ-bench는 23.2에서 51.5로 증가합니다(소매, 통신 및 은행 하위 집합의 평균)

Abridge.title: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare
Abridge.titleEn: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare
Abridge.summary:
Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

Abridge.title: How Maine Health clinician uses the Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleEn: How Maine Health clinician uses the Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleKo: Maine Health 임상의가 진료에 Abridge Assistant를 사용하는 방법
Abridge.summary:
Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of the Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

Writer.title: From “...and?” to “ah-ha!”: How to discover powerful generative AI use cases for your marketing team
Writer.titleEn: From “...and?” to “ah-ha!”: How to discover powerful generative AI use cases for your marketing team
Writer.titleKo: "...그리고?"에서 "아하!"로 · 마케팅 팀을 위한 강력한 생성 AI 사용 사례를 찾는 방법
Writer.summary:
If you log into LinkedIn, or a community forum, or listen to a webinar or podcast, you’ll receive an endless supply of generative AI use cases.
Without a framework for identifying and prioritizing use cases, marketing teams can’t operationalize and scale their use of generative AI.
Generative AI is disrupting industries at a rapid pace, and marketing teams need to plan for continuous use case adoption.
summaryLinesEn: If you log into LinkedIn, or a community forum, or listen to a webinar or podcast, you’ll receive an endless supply of generative AI use cases.
Without a framework for identifying and prioritizing use cases, marketing teams can’t operationalize and scale their use of generative AI.
Generative AI is disrupting industries at a rapid pace, and marketing teams need to plan for continuous use case adoption.
summaryLinesKo: LinkedIn이나 커뮤니티 포럼에 로그인하거나 웹 세미나나 팟캐스트를 들으면 생성 AI 사용 사례를 끝없이 얻을 수 있음

Writer.titleEn: The part of healthcare's cost that payers can fix this year
Writer.titleKo: 올해 의료비 중 납부자가 고칠 수 있는 부분
Writer.summary:
Family coverage through an employer now costs an average of $28,303 a year [1], and employers expect costs to keep climbing — increases have ranged from 5% to 7% annually in recent years [2].
Plans, providers, and employers are all working to bend the cost curve, and it’s genuinely complex: misaligned incentives, fragmented data, years of accumulated process.
Health Affairs research brief, Oct. 2022: administration is 15% to 30% of spending; at least half is wasteful.

Writer.titleKo: 2026년 엔터프라이즈 AI 도입 · 높은 투자에도 불구하고 79%가 문제에 직면하는 이유
Writer.summary:
The 2026 survey findings reveal 79% of organizations face challenges in adopting AI — a double-digit increase from 2025 — with 54% of C-suite executives admitting that adopting AI is tearing their company apart.
WRITER’s 2026 AI adoption in the Enterprise survey , conducted with independent research firm Workplace Intelligence, reveals a defining shift in how executives and employees globally are navigating the biggest technological change in a generation.
Faced with disappointing results, 69% of companies are planning layoffs due to AI, yet 39% don’t even have a formal strategy to drive revenue from these tools.

Writer.title: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
Writer.titleEn: Agentic AI for marketing teams: Use cases from content generation to campaign orchestration
Writer.titleKo: 마케팅 팀을 위한 Agentic AI: 콘텐츠 생성부터 캠페인 조정까지의 사용 사례
Writer.summary:
Agentic AI is the project manager and the team: You give it a strategic goal (e.g., “launch a campaign for our new feature”), and it both orchestrates the entire process AND executes the work — researching competitors, drafting multiple content assets, cross-referencing brand guidelines, and preparing everything for launch.
Meanwhile, your team just launched their third campaign of the week — complete with personalized email sequences, industry-specific landing pages, and sales enablement materials.
And while AI tools promise to solve these challenges, most marketing teams are drowning in a sea of disconnected point solutions, endless prompting sessions, and the constant fear of losing their brand integrity in the rush to keep up.As a result, marketing leaders get caught in an impossible bind — you need both speed AND custom fit.

Meanwhile, your team just launched their third campaign of the week — complete with personalized email sequences, industry-specific landing pages, and sales enablement materials.

With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.

They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.

Meta AI.summary:
Update, November 9, 2026, 2:12PM ET: A previous version of this story indicated that Meta is using bone structure analysis of photos, as well as mentions of things like school grades or birthday celebrations to estimate a person's age.
If the systems determine the person is aged between 13 and 17, they'll be funneled into a teen account, even if they used an adult date of birth while signing up.
In August, the company reached an agreement (under which it may have to pay as much as $18 billion) with 52 attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that alleged harms to young users of its apps.

Meta AI.summary:
Muse Ember leads in most of Meta's own tests, but Haiku outperforms it on real coding tasks in FrontierCode 2.0-AA, scoring 34.9 percent to Muse Ember's 27.2 percent.

It's available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

Meta AI.summary:
The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.
Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.

Meta AI.titleEn: WhatsApp’s AI-powered photo expansion tool starts rolling out on iOS - 9to5Mac
Meta AI.titleKo: WhatsApp의 AI 기반 사진 확장 도구가 iOS에서 출시되기 시작합니다 - 9to5Mac
Meta AI.summary:
Once the process is complete, WhatsApp shows the expanded photo in the drawing editor, and users can choose to send it.
According to WABetaInfo , the platform is rolling out a Meta AI-powered image expansion tool, though it is currently limited to select users, primarily those in WhatsApp’s beta program via TestFlight.
Here are the details. iPhone users with access to Apple Intelligence have a native AI-powered photo expansion tool called Extend , which lets users pinch or drag to expand an image beyond its original borders.
